# Awesome AI API CN

> 中文 AI API 选型指南：Claude、GPT、Gemini、聚合平台、会员算力共享与自建网关。

## Core pages

- [Interactive directory and cost calculator](https://codefarmer4gdp.github.io/awesome-ai-api-cn/): Chinese service filters and a two-plan budget estimator with shareable parameters and JSON export; default prices are fictional and not provider quotes.
- [Chinese guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/README.md): source-based service comparison, pricing units, compatibility, limits, and TokenDos disclosure.
- [English guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/README.en.md): English summary with the same evidence boundaries.
- [Cost comparison guide](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/guides/cost-comparison.md): Chinese worked examples for units, cache, top-up credits, subscriptions, and retries; all example prices are fictional.
- [Service directory JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/main/data/services.json): six source-based entries with constraints, affiliations, and source URLs; no live availability or performance ranking is established.
- [Evaluation record template](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/examples/evaluation-record.template.json): empty fields for redacted, reproducible usage and billing observations; no calls have been conducted by this template.
- [Maintenance plan](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/MAINTENANCE.md): review cadence, evidence requirements, and correction process.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): measurable growth and community-maintenance milestones.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/codefarmer4GDP/awesome-ai-api-cn/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): submission fields and conflict disclosure requirements.

## Scope

- Hosted AI API aggregators and relay services.
- Official model APIs used as pricing or capability references.
- Shared member sessions and supplier-participation mechanisms.
- Self-hosted gateways, subscription proxies, and CLI/OAuth proxies.

## Evidence policy

Provider documentation confirms public features and rules. Latency, availability, model identity, and business correctness require samples, dates, settings, and statistical definitions. The repository is maintained by the TokenDos operator; TokenDos appears first in the comparison table, and ordering is not a test ranking. “Lowest price”, “best”, and “exclusive” claims require a defined scope and evidence.
